sentences: NTRU-like problems use structured algebraic relations involving short secret elements.
The survey asks for worst-case reductions or reductions connecting search with decision versions.
Recovering a hidden object can differ substantially from merely distinguishing its induced distribution from a comparison distribution.
A strong connection would place these assumptions within a more systematic complexity framework.
The saved historical note does not identify one NTRU variant or its distributions, so reductions for a neighboring ring problem cannot automatically supply the requested guarantees.
